ABOUT AMPLIQ

About us

A growth partner bringing marketing, HR and technology together under one roof.

We turn goals into tangible results

Ampliq is a Saudi group headquartered in Riyadh, specializing in digital marketing, human resources management, and web & software development.

We work as an extension of our clients’ teams across government entities, educational institutions and private companies. We start by understanding where you are today, then build the strategy, deliver it and measure its impact — turning goals into tangible results.

We believe an organization doesn’t have to build every function in-house from day one. That’s why we provide a complete team of experts — at a flexible cost, with measurable results.

  • Digital marketing

    We create demand and drive growth

  • Human resources

    We build teams and organize the workplace

  • Web & software development

    We build your digital presence

VISION & MISSION

Our vision & mission

Our vision

To be the smartest growth partner for organizations in Saudi Arabia, through marketing, management and technology solutions that create measurable impact and support Vision 2030’s goals of empowering the private sector and raising institutional efficiency.

Our mission

We deliver integrated marketing, human resources, and web & software development services that combine hands-on expertise, data and technology — raising our clients’ efficiency, accelerating their growth, and relieving them of the burden of building every function in-house.
